module origen_086052 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire din,
    output reg dout,
    output reg [11:0] res,
    output reg cs,
    output reg valid
);

    reg [11:0] cmd = 12'b100000110000;
    reg [15:0] shftin;
    reg [15:0] shftout;
    reg [7:0] cnt;
    reg [11:0] rtmp;
    reg cstmp, vtmp, outtmp;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        cnt <= (cnt == 8'd249) ? 8'd0 : cnt + 8'd1;

        case (cnt)
            8'd0: begin
                shftout <= {cmd, 4'b0000};
                cstmp <= 1'b0;
                vtmp <= 1'b0;
            end
            8'd1, 8'd2, 8'd3, 8'd4, 8'd5, 8'd6, 8'd7, 8'd8,
            8'd9, 8'd10, 8'd11, 8'd12, 8'd13, 8'd14, 8'd15: begin
                shftin <= {shftin[14:0], din};
                shftout <= {shftout[14:0], 1'b0};
                outtmp <= shftout[15];
            end
            8'd16: begin
                cstmp <= 1'b1;
                outtmp <= shftout[15];
            end
            8'd17: rtmp <= shftin[11:0];
            8'd18: vtmp <= 1'b1;
            8'd19: vtmp <= 1'b0;
            default: begin
                cstmp <= 1'b1;
                vtmp <= 1'b0;
                outtmp <= 1'b1;
            end
        endcase
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        cs <= cstmp;
        valid <= vtmp;
        dout <= outtmp;
        res <= rtmp;
    end

endmodule
